note: Tool-command cases call the same pinned handler down both arms, over the same fixture, so the replies are compared whole; a bespoke CLI answers in its own shape and is projected onto the same fact. Every google-cloud projection ends in `grep .`, so an arm whose reply carries no such line fails the case instead of agreeing on nothing.

cases.name: google_cloud_run_query
cases.why: the same statement returns the same answer through either arm

args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM game_analytics.player_historical_stats

mirage.command: google-cloud bigquery-run-query '{"query":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM game_analytics.player_historical_stats"}'
